mapper.select: SELECT id FROM assessment_attempt WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status='IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY id
SELECT status FROM assessment_attempt WHERE id=#{attemptId} AND task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT p.candidate_name,p.phone FROM assessment_participant p JOIN assessment_attempt a ON a.participant_id=p.id WHERE a.id=#{attemptId} AND p.task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT option_key `key`,option_text text FROM question_option WHERE question_id=#{questionId} ORDER BY sort_no,id
SELECT id,attempt_count FROM assessment_participant WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND candidate_name=#{candidateName} AND phone=#{phone} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE assessment_participant p JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id=p.task_id LEFT JOIN training tr ON tr.assessment_id=t.id LEFT JOIN training_audience ta ON ta.training_id=tr.id AND ta.candidate_name=p.candidate_name AND ta.phone=p.phone LEFT JOIN organization_employee e ON e.created_by=t.created_by AND e.name=p.candidate_name AND e.phone=p.phone SET p.employee_id=COALESCE(ta.employee_id,e.id) WHERE p.id=#{participantId} AND p.employee_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id,attempt_no,started_at FROM assessment_attempt WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND participant_id=#{participantId} AND status='IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,attempt_no,started_at,submitted_at,score,total_score,passed FROM assessment_attempt WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND participant_id=#{participantId} AND status='SUBMITTED' ORDER BY attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT question_id,answer_text FROM assessment_answer WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_attempt(task_id,participant_id,attempt_no,status,total_score,started_at,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{taskId},#{participantId},#{attemptNumber}, 'IN_PROGRESS',p.total_score,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM test_paper p JOIN assessment_task a ON a.paper_id=p.id WHERE a.id=#{sourceTaskId}
mapper.select: SELECT started_at FROM assessment_attempt WHERE id=#{attemptId}
SELECT question_id,answer_text FROM assessment_answer WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId}
SELECT id,attempt_count FROM assessment_participant WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND candidate_name=#{candidateName} AND phone=#{phone} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM assessment_attempt WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND participant_id=#{participantId} AND status='IN_PROGRESS' LIMIT 1

SELECT aa.id attempt_id,aa.started_at FROM assessment_attempt aa JOIN assessment_participant ap ON ap.id=aa.participant_id WHERE aa.task_id=#{taskId} AND ap.candidate_name=#{candidateName} AND ap.phone=#{phone} AND aa.status='IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY aa.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT question_id,answer_text FROM assessment_answer WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId}
SELECT q.question_type,q.answer_text,aq.score FROM assessment_attempt_question aq JOIN question_item q ON q.id=aq.question_id WHERE aq.attempt_id=#{attemptId} AND aq.question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_answer(attempt_id,question_id,answer_text,correct_answer,is_correct,score,answered_at) VALUES(#{attemptId},#{questionId},#{answer},#{correctAnswer},#{correct},#{score},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE answer_text=VALUES(answer_text),correct_answer=VALUES(correct_answer),is_correct=VALUES(is_correct),score=VALUES(score),answered_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT a.task_id,a.participant_id,a.attempt_no,t.paper_id,t.allow_retake allowRetake,t.max_attempts maxAttempts,p.total_score,p.pass_score FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id=a.task_id JOIN test_paper p ON p.id=t.paper_id WHERE a.id=#{attemptId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment_attempt_question WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT question_id) FROM assessment_answer WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId} AND answer_text IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(answer_text)<>''
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(score),0) FROM assessment_answer WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId}

SELECT t.name title,a.score,a.total_score totalScore,a.passed,a.submitted_at submittedAt FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_participant p ON p.id=a.participant_id JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id=a.task_id WHERE a.task_id=#{taskId} AND p.phone=#{phone} AND a.status='SUBMITTED' ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT a.id attemptId,a.task_id taskId,a.attempt_no attemptNo,a.status,a.score,a.total_score totalScore,p.pass_score passScore,a.passed,a.started_at startedAt,a.submitted_at submittedAt,ap.candidate_name candidateName,ap.phone,t.allow_retake allowRetake,t.max_attempts maxAttempts,t.show_result_immediately reviewEnabled FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id=a.task_id JOIN test_paper p ON p.id=t.paper_id JOIN assessment_participant ap ON ap.id=a.participant_id WHERE a.id=#{attemptId}
SELECT question_id questionId,answer_text answerText,is_correct isCorrect,score FROM assessment_answer WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId} ORDER BY question_id

SELECT a.id,a.name title,p.name subtitle,p.id paperId,p.mode paperMode,CASE WHEN p.mode='RANDOM' THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.single_count+r.multiple_count+r.true_false_count) FROM test_paper_random_bank r WHERE r.paper_id=p.id),0) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_paper_question pq WHERE pq.paper_id=p.id) END questionCount,a.duration_minutes duration,p.total_score totalScore,p.pass_score passScore,a.allow_retake allowRetake,a.max_attempts maxAttempts,a.start_at startAt,a.end_at endAt,(SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tr.start_at)*1000 FROM training tr WHERE tr.assessment_id=a.id) trainingStartAt,(SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tr.end_at)*1000 FROM training tr WHERE tr.assessment_id=a.id) trainingEndAt,CASE WHEN a.end_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 'ENDED' ELSE a.status END taskStatus,a.show_result_immediately reviewEnabled FROM assessment_task a JOIN test_paper p ON p.id=a.paper_id WHERE a.id=#{taskId}

choose.when: SELECT q.id,q.question_type,q.stem,q.answer_text,q.analysis,pq.score FROM assessment_task a JOIN test_paper_question pq ON pq.paper_id=a.paper_id JOIN question_item q ON q.id=pq.question_id WHERE a.id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY pq.sort_no,pq.id
choose.otherwise: SELECT q.id,q.question_type,q.stem,q.answer_text,q.analysis,aq.score FROM assessment_attempt_question aq JOIN question_item q ON q.id=aq.question_id WHERE aq.attempt_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY aq.sort_no,aq.id

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment_attempt_question WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId}
SELECT paper_id FROM assessment_task WHERE id=#{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_attempt_question(attempt_id,question_id,score,sort_no) SELECT #{attemptId},question_id,score,sort_no FROM test_paper_question WHERE paper_id=#{paperId} ORDER BY sort_no,id
mapper.select: SELECT bank_id,single_count,single_score,multiple_count,multiple_score,true_false_count,true_false_score FROM test_paper_random_bank WHERE paper_id=#{paperId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM question_item WHERE bank_id=#{bankId} AND question_type=#{questionType} AND status='ENABLED'
SELECT p.task_id,p.candidate_name,p.phone FROM assessment_participant p JOIN assessment_attempt a ON a.participant_id=p.id WHERE a.id=#{attemptId}

SELECT a.id,a.status,a.started_at startedAt, (SELECT t.duration_minutes FROM assessment_task t WHERE t.id=a.task_id) duration, (SELECT t.status FROM assessment_task t WHERE t.id=a.task_id) taskStatus, (SELECT t.start_at FROM assessment_task t WHERE t.id=a.task_id) startAt, (SELECT t.end_at FROM assessment_task t WHERE t.id=a.task_id) endAt, (SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tr.start_at)*1000 FROM training tr WHERE tr.assessment_id=a.task_id) trainingStartAt, (SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tr.end_at)*1000 FROM training tr WHERE tr.assessment_id=a.task_id) trainingEndAt FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE a.id=#{attemptId} FOR UPDATE
